VBO:0201040.summary: Affectionate and energetic in his owner’s account, two-and-a-half-year-old Titan is a Pomapug, a Pomeranian–Pug cross. He enjoys walks and chewing toys, and rests his head on a person’s leg when he wants to be invited up for a cuddle. His family also reports grabbing and dragging their cat by a leg and repeatedly nipping the children’s heels—part of this individual account, alongside his affection.
